name: Gregor Matl
headline: Working passionately to improve computer science education in schools.
summary:
Algorithms often seem abstract. At Algonautin, our mission is to make algorithms visual, intuitive, and fun. We boost the quality of computer science education while unburdening teachers and contributing to educational equity.

Thanks to a partnership with the German National Computer Science Competition (BWINF), our educational platform is available free of charge to German schools and is currently used by over 1300 teachers. Try it now at https://algo.bwinf.de

My background:

After being the overall winner of the German National Computer Science Competition in 2014, I've had the privilege of coaching the national team for the olympiade in computer science for over a decade. In this capacity, other passionate coaches and I have used and developed advanced programming tasks and automated evaluation systems. Our goal now is to make this technology more widely available to high schools and universities.

company.name: Algonautin
company.description:
Understanding algorithms is more important than ever before. Meanwhile, education systems worldwide struggle to keep up with the rapid pace of technological development. We solve the problem by providing a fully automated computer science learning platform. Our intelligent evaluation system can understand the approach of individual solutions and provide reliable and detailed feedback. Engaging animations allow learners to visualize their algorithmic ideas to gain an intuitive understanding of even abstract concepts.

Our goal is to make quality computer science education accessible online to pupils and students regardless of geography, gender, or wealth. Teachers and students in German schools already enjoy free access to our system thanks to a broad license by the Bundesweite Informatikwettbewerbe (BWINF): Try it at algo.bwinf.de

Our team consists of experts in computer science and mathematics as well as experienced teachers and UX experts. We have decades of coaching experience in international computer science competitions, and many team members have won such competitions as participants. For example, one IOI and one IMO gold medalist, three ICPC World Finalists and one overall winner in the German National Competition in Computer Science are part of our team.
